title: New Sonos Play Portable Speaker With AirPlay 2 Leaks on Best Buy
desc: Say hello to the Sonos Play – a new unannounced portable speaker that appears to have been accidentally leaked on the Canadian Best Buy site. Priced at CAD $399.99, the speaker looks a lot like a smaller version of the Sonos Move 2, and features Wi-Fi for multi-room setups of up to 32 speakers, AirPlay 2 support, and Bluetooth 5.3. There's also an aux-in for connecting record players and other equipment.

title: Encryption Integration Solution to Build a Quantum
desc: At MWC Barcelona 2026, Huawei launched the Xinghe Intelligent Traffic-Encryption Integration Solution, which integrates network intelligence and quantum security. This innovative solution tackles two challenges—mitigating quantum security threats and slashing enterprise network construction costs—in order to help industries worldwide accelerate their transition to become quantum-secure.
